ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course is for students in the Peoria cohort. This site-based course beings January 21st and ends May 6th. Class sessions will be held on Wednesday evenings in room A-200-2 at the University of Illinois, College of Medicine, One Illini Drive from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. The email address for the instructor is PaulNKimK@msn.com
